title: Raw job
description: One posting as the collector read it, before tagging. The collector fills everything a feed states or a location rule can decide. The tagger adds disciplines, level, pay found in the posting text, summary and the tagging record, and drops description_text and department to produce a Job (job.schema.json). The collector keeps every posting on a board, hardware or not; the tagger decides which are in scope.

workplace.description: From a feed field or a location rule. 'unknown' when neither decides; the tagger may refine it from the posting text.

pay.description: Only when the feed carries pay as structured data (basis 'feed'). Pay written in the posting text is the tagger's job; leave null here.

department.description: Department or team as the feed names it, parts joined with ' / '. Null when the feed has none.

description_text.description: The posting body as plain text: tags removed, entities decoded, whitespace collapsed, cut to 20,000 characters. Empty string when the feed gives no body.
